description: Offline training-only maritime instrument simulation foundation

scripts.check: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'),path=require('node:path'),cp=require('node:child_process');const walk=d=>fs.readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true}).flatMap(e=>{const p=path.join(d,e.name);return e.isDirectory()?walk(p):p;});const files=[...walk('src'),...walk('web'),...fs.readdirSync('tools').map(n=>path.join('tools',n))].filter(f=>f.endsWith('.mjs')).sort();for(const f of files)cp.execFileSync(process.execPath,['--check',f],{stdio:'inherit'});" && npm test
